about: Invoice / Packing List(C000652) — 2026-10-04 원본 실측: 목록 탭 [전체 · 미확인 · 확인], 열 [Voucher Date · Customer · Item Name('첫 품목 외 n건') · Invoice No. · Invoice Date · Foreign Currency · Amount · Invoice · P/L], 입력 창 머리(L/C · Shipper · Notify Party · Port of Loading · Carrier …) · 줄(Mark · Description · Net/Gross Weight · Measurement). 두 줄 인보이스를 만들어 목록 · 수정(Carrier) · 진행상태변경(확인 탭) 을 보고 지운다. 2026-10-12: 원본 [Invoice 번호] 는 비우면 비운 채로 두어(번호를 짓지 않는다) 첫 흐름은 번호를 적어 넣는다. 둘째 흐름은 [판매] 불러오기 · [매핑조회] 채움 · 통화 '내자' 기본.

shots.name: 두 줄 인보이스 → 목록 '외 1건' → Voucher Date 눌러 수정 → 진행상태변경 확인 → 지움
steps: wait:2000

js:(async () => { const A = (m, u, b) => fetch('/api' + u, { method: m, headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token'), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then((r) => r.json()); const [pa, it, cu] = await Promise.all([A('GET', '/partners'), A('GET', '/items'), A('GET', '/currencies')]); const c = pa.find((x) => x.type === 'CUSTOMER' || x.type === 'BOTH'); const usd = cu.find((x) => x.code === 'USD') ?? cu.find((x) => x.latestRate != null); const r = await A('POST', '/exports', { partnerId: c.id, currencyId: usd.id, shipper: 'QA재고2 Shipper', notifyParty: 'QA Notify', portOfLoading: 'BUSAN', destination: 'LA', invoiceNo: 'QA재고2-' + Date.now().toString().slice(-8), remark: 'QA재고2', lines: [{ itemId: it[0].id, quantity: 2, unitPrice: 10, marks: 'QA-M1', netWeight: 1.5 }, { itemId: it[1].id, quantity: 1, unitPrice: 5 }] }); sessionStorage.setItem('exId', r.id); sessionStorage.setItem('exNo', r.invoiceNo); return r.invoiceNo + ' ' + r.foreignAmount })()

wait:3000

js:(async () => { const W = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const A = (m, u, b) => fetch('/api' + u, { method: m, headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token'), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then((r) => r.status === 204 ? null : r.json()); const sales = await A('GET', '/sales?from=' + new Date(Date.now() - 29*864e5).toISOString().slice(0,10) + '&to=' + new Date(Date.now() + 30*864e5).toISOString().slice(0,10)); const s = sales.find((x) => x.lines.length > 0 && x.lines.every((l) => Number(l.quantity) > 0 && Number(l.unitPrice) > 0)); const ex = await A('GET', '/exports'); const before = ex.exports.filter((e) => e.partnerId === s.partnerId).length; const m = await A('POST', '/exports', { partnerId: s.partnerId, currencyId: null, shipper: 'QA재고2 Map Shipper', portOfLoading: 'QA BUSAN', remark: 'QA재고2', lines: [{ itemId: s.lines[0].itemId, quantity: 1, unitPrice: 1 }] }); sessionStorage.setItem('mapEx', m.id); sessionStorage.setItem('saleDoc', s.docNo); sessionStorage.setItem('salePartner', s.partnerId); sessionStorage.setItem('saleLines', s.lines.length); sessionStorage.setItem('before', before); return s.docNo + ' ' + s.partnerName })()
